exposure: Pre-eclampsia status (study group vs. control group)
outcome: Perinatal outcomes (uneventful births, intrauterine growth restriction, intrauterine distress, premature infants, neonatal deaths)
Diagnostic accuracy of Hoxb3, sFlt-1, and their combination for pre-eclampsia
Predictive accuracy of Hoxb3, sFlt-1, and their combination for poor perinatal outcomes
cohort: The study involved 103 pre-eclamptic patients (study group) and 100 healthy pregnant women (control group).
finding: Hoxb3 and sFlt-1 levels differed significantly between pre-eclamptic and healthy pregnant women and showed potential as diagnostic and prognostic markers for pre-eclampsia and adverse perinatal outcomes.
